selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What action does the passage say Allah carries out through His command of creation?
questions.answer: He restores the earth to life.

questions.question: According to the passage, how are people and jinn brought to the place of resurrection?
questions.answer: They are brought together by one command, described as a single cry.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about how long resurrection and gathering will take?
questions.answer: It will happen extremely quickly, in less time than a blink or about that fast.

questions.question: In the passage, what comparison is made to show the ease of creating and resurrecting all people?
questions.answer: Bringing all of them into being again is said to be as easy as bringing one soul into being.

questions.question: Which groups besides human beings are mentioned as being gathered at the Supreme Gathering?
questions.answer: Jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels are also mentioned.

questions.question: What is meant by saying one concern does not interfere with another?
questions.answer: Handling countless beings at once causes no difficulty or distraction for Allah.

questions.question: What main idea ties the three cited verses together in this passage?
questions.answer: They all show that resurrection for all creatures is easy, swift, and done by Allah’s single command.

questions.question: Based on the passage, why is the resurrection of every creature not presented as a difficult task?
questions.answer: Because Allah’s power reaches all of them together with complete ease.

questions.question: How does the passage end its discussion of these mysteries?
questions.answer: It says the later mysteries, from the third to the thirteenth, are delayed until another time.

questions.question: What note does the speaker add about the later mysteries?
questions.answer: He says they have been postponed, even though he is not pleased about delaying them.

questions.question: What happens to the earth through Allah’s creative order in this passage?
questions.answer: It is revived and brought back to life.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the call that gathers creation for resurrection?
questions.answer: It describes it as one call that brings them all into Allah’s presence.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the speed of the Last Hour and the gathering after it?
questions.answer: It teaches that both will occur with amazing speed, faster than people would normally imagine.

questions.question: How is the resurrection of all people compared with the resurrection of one individual?
questions.answer: There is no difference in difficulty; both are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: Who will be assembled in the field of the Supreme Gathering according to the passage?
questions.answer: Human beings, jinn, animals, spiritual creatures, and angels.

questions.question: What does the phrase about a single command show about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah does not need many separate actions to gather all creation.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both creation and resurrection together?
questions.answer: To show that giving life the first time and bringing it back again are both easy for Allah.

questions.question: What can a student infer from the statement that one matter does not disturb another?
questions.answer: Allah’s care for one creature never prevents Him from dealing perfectly with all others.

questions.question: What is the central message of this target passage?
questions.answer: The resurrection of all creatures is certain, immediate by Allah’s command, and effortless for Him.

questions.question: How does the passage close after discussing these verses?
questions.answer: It closes by saying the rest of the mysteries will be explained later.

questions.question: At the beginning of the passage, what result comes from Allah’s command of creation?
questions.answer: The earth is made alive again.

questions.question: What is the effect of the single cry mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: It gathers all people and jinn and brings them forward together.

questions.question: How does the image of a blink help explain resurrection?
questions.answer: It shows that the event will happen with extreme quickness.

questions.question: What lesson is taught by the statement that all people are like one soul in creation and resurrection?
questions.answer: Allah’s power is not strained by large numbers, so all humanity is no harder than one person.
